crew.overview: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren work to help a family terrorized by a dark presence in their farmhouse. Forced to confront a powerful entity, the Warrens find themselves caught in the most terrifying case of their lives.
crew.title: The Conjuring

details.biography: Tree O'Toole lives in Los Angeles and calls North Carolina home. She has two older brothers and a younger sister. Her nieces and nephews are her pride and joy! Tree was born in St. Louis, Missouri and the majority of her relatives live in MO and Illinois. She graduated from West Carteret High School in Morehead City, North Carolina. Her father retired from the USMC a few years back, as a full bird Col. (Mustang). She has been blessed with down to earth and loving family and friends.
details.name: Tree O'Toole
